name: vscode-universal-dictate
description: Local, offline dictation for VS Code on Windows and Remote - WSL. 99 languages, optional live transcript preview, clipboard recovery, and no automatic sending.

universalDictate.language.description: Whisper language code used for local transcription. Default: English (`en`). Use 'Universal Dictate: Select Language' to choose Auto-detect or any of the 99 languages supported by the bundled multilingual base model.

enumDescriptions: Show the enhanced native recording overlay and the animated status-bar waveform.
Show the enhanced native overlay; keep static recording feedback in the status bar.
Show only the animated status-bar waveform; do not create the native overlay.
Disable overlay and status-bar audio visualizations; keep static recording feedback in the status bar.
universalDictate.visualization.description: Controls recording visualizations. Default: enhanced overlay. Changes apply from the next dictation session.

enumDescriptions: Keep the existing scrolling speech waveform. Default; no spectral analysis.
Show FFT power over time with logarithmic frequency spacing (62.5 Hz to 8 kHz).
Show FFT power over time with linear frequency spacing (0 to 8 kHz).
Show power from variable-length constant-Q filters (62.5 Hz to about 7.55 kHz); more low-frequency resolution and a longer startup window.
Arrange the latest FFT spectrum around a circle. Not a chromagram; the history duration does not apply.
universalDictate.enhancedOverlayVisualiz.description: Visualization drawn inside the enhanced native recording overlay. Used only when Audio visualization is Enhanced overlay or Both. Does not change the status bar or enable the overlay. Changes apply from the next dictation session.

enumDescriptions: Use the compact enhanced recording overlay.
Use the medium enhanced recording overlay.
Use the current large enhanced recording overlay.
universalDictate.overlaySize.description: Size of the enhanced native recording overlay. Default: medium. Changes apply from the next dictation session.

universalDictate.waveformTimeSpanSeconds.description: Amount of recent active audio, in seconds, shown across the enhanced waveform or scrolling spectrogram. Does not apply to Circular Spectrum. The existing saved preference is preserved. Changes apply from the next dictation session.

universalDictate.overwriteClipboard.description: Always insert dictated text automatically into the currently focused input. When enabled, also copy the transcript to the clipboard, replacing its contents and keeping the transcript there even if insertion has no target. When disabled (default), never access the clipboard. Applies from the next dictation session.

universalDictate.livePreview.description: Show provisional text while recording in the enhanced overlay. Disabled by default; when disabled no preview audio snapshots or extra inference run. Requires Enhanced overlay or Both visualization. Changes apply from the next recording. The complete recording is still transcribed and inserted once after Stop.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --target win32-x64 --out universal-dictate-win32-x64.vsix
scripts.test:m2: npm run compile && node --test test/transcript-recovery.test.cjs test/transcript-recovery-ui.test.cjs test/text-input.test.cjs test/lifecycle.test.cjs test/recorder-lifecycle.test.cjs
scripts.test:latency: npm run compile && node --unhandled-rejections=strict --test test/*latency*.test.cjs test/whisper-worker.test.cjs test/preview-runtime.test.cjs
